privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Privacy policy for Azkar - learn how we handle your data.
privacy.subtitle: We believe your privacy is a basic right
privacy.summary: Azkar does not collect, share, or sell personal data. Everything stays on your device.
privacy.openSource: The app is fully open source, so you can inspect the code yourself

collection: Azkar does not collect personal data. The app runs locally without accounts or sign-in, and your settings and custom adhkar are stored only on your device.
location: If you enable prayer times, the app requests approximate location access to calculate local prayer times. This data is not sent to external servers.
storage: The app uses local storage to save preferences, notification settings, and adhkar state. This data never leaves your device.
thirdParty: The app checks GitHub Releases for updates. This request contains no personal data and is used only to compare versions.
analytics: The app does not use tracking or analytics tools. There are no tracking cookies, ads, or third-party data sharing.
children: The app is suitable for all ages. Since no personal data is collected, there are no special child-privacy concerns.
changes: If this policy changes, we will announce it on the project's GitHub releases page. Continued use means accepting the changes.
contact: If you have questions about this policy, open an issue in the project's GitHub repository.

prayer.timesDesc: Times are calculated using current settings and saved location.
